title: Normalized transpose factorization
statement: Fix schemes $X,S,W,V$ [def-pc-scheme], $f:X\to S$, an $\mathcal O_X$-module $L$, $k:W\to S$, and $r:V\to W$, with the shared derived categories [def-pc-derived-category]. Write $X_U=X\times_S U$ and $q_U:X_U\to X$, $p_U:X_U\to U$ for its projections, using $k$ for $U=W$ and $r\gg k$ for $U=V$. Put $M=q_W^\otimes L$ and $E=Rp_{W*}(M[0])$. Construct $B_r:Lr^*E\to Rp_{V*}(q_V^\otimes L[0])$ by canonical derived base change [def-pc-derived-base-change-map], the single-pullback coefficient comparison [lem-pc-canonical-single-pullback-comparison], and the ordinary-to-tensor comparison supplied by left-adjoint uniqueness [lem-pc-module-pullback-adjunction]. Let $\tau_r$ be its transpose under the pinned derived adjunction. Let $e_r:Lr^*\mathcal O_W[0]\cong\mathcal O_V[0]$ be the single-pullback structure-sheaf comparison followed by the unit map. For any test section $\zeta:Lr^*(\mathcal O_W[0])\to Lr^*E$ [def-sc-picard-derived-model-sections], the normalized transpose [def-sc-picard-direct-image-derived-transpose] equals $Lp_V^*(e_r^{-1}\gg\zeta)\gg\tau_r$. There is only one base-change square, no second restriction or pasting comparison, and no coefficient map is inverted. The two explicit constructions are named in [def-sc-picard-coefficient-transpose, def-sc-picard-derived-unit-normalization].

proof.text: Expand the definition of picardDirectImageDerivedTranspose. Its argument under the pinned inverse Hom equivalence is e.inv followed by zeta followed by B. Reassociate this to (e.inv followed by zeta) followed by B. Apply Adjunction.homEquiv_naturality_left_symm to factor out derived pullback of the normalized section. The remaining inverse Hom equivalence applied to B is precisely tau. No square composition or source restriction is involved.

theorem picardDirectImageDerivedTranspose_factorization
    {X S : Scheme.{v}} (f : X ⟶ S)
    (L : X.Modules) (W : Scheme.{v}) (k : W ⟶ S)
    {V : Scheme.{v}} (r : V ⟶ W)
    (ζ : picardDerivedModelSections
      ((schemeDerivedDirectImage (pullback.snd f k)).obj
        ((DerivedCategory.singleFunctor
          (SheafOfModules.{v} (moduleRings (pullback f k).toRingedSpace)) 0).obj
            ((Modules.tensorPullback (pullback.fst f k)).obj L))) r) :
  let τ : ∀ {V : Scheme.{v}} (r : V ⟶ W),
    (derivedPullback (pullback.snd f (r ≫ k))).obj
      ((derivedPullback r).obj
        ((schemeDerivedDirectImage (pullback.snd f k)).obj
          ((DerivedCategory.singleFunctor
            (SheafOfModules.{v} (moduleRings (pullback f k).toRingedSpace)) 0).obj
              ((Modules.tensorPullback (pullback.fst f k)).obj L)))) ⟶
      (DerivedCategory.singleFunctor
        (SheafOfModules.{v} (moduleRings (pullback f (r ≫ k)).toRingedSpace)) 0).obj
          ((Modules.tensorPullback (pullback.fst f (r ≫ k))).obj L) :=
    picardCoefficientTranspose f L W k
  let e : ∀ {V : Scheme.{v}} (r : V ⟶ W),
    (derivedPullback r).obj
      ((DerivedCategory.singleFunctor
        (SheafOfModules.{v} (moduleRings W.toRingedSpace)) 0).obj
          (SheafOfModules.unit (moduleRings W.toRingedSpace))) ≅
      (DerivedCategory.singleFunctor
        (SheafOfModules.{v} (moduleRings V.toRingedSpace)) 0).obj
          (SheafOfModules.unit (moduleRings V.toRingedSpace)) :=
    picardDerivedUnitNormalization W
  picardDirectImageDerivedTranspose f L W k r ζ =
    (derivedPullback (pullback.snd f (r ≫ k))).map ((e r).inv ≫ ζ) ≫ τ r
